speaker: choir
text: In Thy Kingdom remember us, O Lord, when Thou comest in Thy Kingdom.

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the Kingdom of heaven.

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are they that hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be sated.

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

speaker: reader
label: Resurrection
text: Through food did the enemy lead Adam forth from paradise; but by the Cross hath Christ led back to it the thief who cried: Remember me when Thou comest in Thy Kingdom!

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are the clean of heart: for they shall see God.

speaker: reader
label: Resurrection
text: With Adam and the thief I worship Thy sufferings and glorify Thy resurrection; and I cry out with a splendid voice: Remember me, O Lord, when Thou comest in Thy Kingdom!

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

speaker: reader
label: Resurrection
text: O Sinless One, of Thine own will Thou wast crucified and placed in the Tomb, yet Thou didst arise as God, raising up with Thyself Adam who crieth out: Remember me when Thou comest in Thy Kingdom!

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness sake: for theirs is the Kingdom of heaven.

speaker: reader
label: Resurrection
text: Raising up the temple of Thy body by Thy resurrection on the third day, O Christ God, Thou didst raise up Adam and his descendants who cry: Remember me when Thou comest in Thy Kingdom!

speaker: choir
text: Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you and persecute you, and shall say every evil against you falsely for my sake.

speaker: reader
label: Resurrection
text: Very early, the myrrh-bearing women arrived, weeping, at Thy tomb, O Christ God; and they found an angel sitting there, clad in white garments, who said: What seek ye? Christ is risen! Lament no longer!

speaker: choir
text: Rejoice, and be glad: for great is your reward in heaven.

speaker: reader
label: Resurrection
text: When Thine apostles went to the mountain whither Thou hadst commanded them to go, and saw Thee, O Savior, they worshipped Thee; and Thou didst send them unto the nations, to teach and baptize them.
Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit,

speaker: reader
label: Glory
text: Let us worship the Father, let us glorify the Son, and together let us hymn the all-holy Spirit, crying out and saying: O most Holy Trinity, save us all!
Both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

speaker: reader
label: Theotokion
text: Thy people bring Thy Mother before Thee to make supplication, O Christ. Through her entreaties grant us Thy compassions, O Good One, that we may glorify Thee Who hast shone forth upon us from the tomb.
The clergy make the Little Entrance with the Gospel Book.

speaker: deacon
text: Wisdom! Attend!

speaker: choir
text: Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ. O Son of God, who art risen from the dead, save us who sing to Thee: Alleluia!
Troparion of the Resurrection, Tone 1:

speaker: choir
text: When the stone had been sealed by the Jews, while the soldiers were guarding Thy most pure body, Thou didst rise on the third day, O Savior, granting life to the world. The powers of heaven therefore cried to Thee, O Giver of Life: Glory to Thy Resurrection, O Christ! Glory to Thy Kingdom! Glory to Thy dispensation, O Thou Who lovest mankind!
Troparion of the Patron of the Temple, Venerable John of Damascus, Tone 3:

speaker: choir
text: Thou wast a holy instrument and a tuneful harp of godliness. Thy teaching shone forth to the ends of the world, O righteous John of Damascus. We pray thee to entreat Christ our God to grant us His great mercy.
Troparion of Venerable Xenia of Rome, and her two female servants, Tone 3:

speaker: choir
text:
Living the life of a stranger in the world,
thou didst estrang thyself from every sin;
thou didst abandon comforts and fleeting honors
and betrothed thyself to thine Immortal Bridegroom.
Glorious Xenia, entreat Christ our God to grant us His great mercy.
Kontakion of the Resurrection, Tone 1:

speaker: choir
text: Thou hast risen from the grave as God in glory, raising the world with Thyself. Human nature praises Thee as God, for death has vanished. Adam exults, O Master; Eve rejoices, for she is freed from bondage and cries to Thee: Thou art the Giver of Resurrection to all, O Christ!
Kontakion of the Patron of the Temple, Venerable John of Damascus, Tone 4:

speaker: choir
text: Let us praise the illustrious hymnographer, John, teacher of the Church and champion against her enemies. For armed with the weapon of the Lord's Cross, he has banished the errors of heresy. He fervently intercedes with God who grants forgiveness to all.
Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit.
Kontakion of Venerable Xenia of Rome, and her two female servants, Tone 2:

speaker: choir
text:
We celebrate the memory of the life thou didst live as a stranger in the world,
and as we honor thee with love, O Xenia,
we praise Christ, who gave thee power to grant healing to all;
ever pray to Him on our behalf.
Now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.
Kontakion-Theotokion, Tone 6:

speaker: choir
text: Steadfast Protectress of Christians, Constant Advocate before the Creator; despise not the cries of us sinners, but in thy goodness come speedily to help us who call on thee in faith. Hasten to hear our petition and to intercede for us, O Theotokos, for thou always protect those who honor thee!

speaker: deacon
text: Let us pray to the Lord.

speaker: choir
text: Lord, have mercy.

speaker: deacon
text: O Lord, save the pious.

speaker: choir
text: O Lord, save the pious.

speaker: deacon
text: And hear us.

speaker: choir
text: And hear us.

speaker: priest
text: And unto ages of ages. Amen.

speaker: choir
text: Amen.
Sung three times:

speaker: choir
text: Holy God, Holy Mighty, Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.
Svyatyi Bozhe, Svyatyi Krépkii, Svyatyi Bezsmértnyi, pomíluy nas.
Ágios o Theós, Ágios Ischyrós, Ágios Athánatos, eleíson imás.
Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

speaker: choir
text: Holy Immortal, have mercy on us.

speaker: priest
text: Peace be unto all.

speaker: choir
text: And to thy spirit.

speaker: deacon
text: The prokeimenon in Tone 1.

speaker: choir
text: Let Thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, as we have set our hope on Thee!

speaker: reader
text: V. Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous! Praise befits the just!

speaker: choir
text: Let Thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, as we have set our hope on Thee!

speaker: deacon
text: Wisdom!

speaker: reader
text: The reading from the Epistle of the Holy Apostle Paul to the Colossians.

speaker: deacon
text: Let us attend.
Colossians 3:4–11

speaker: priest
text: Peace be unto thee.

speaker: choir
text: And to thy spirit.
Alleluia in Tone 1.

speaker: choir
text: Alleluia! Alleluia! Alleluia!

speaker: reader
text: V. God gives vengeance unto me, and subdues people under me.

speaker: choir
text: Alleluia!

speaker: reader
text: V. He magnifies the salvation of the King and deals mercifully with David, His anointed, and his seed forever.

speaker: choir
text: Alleluia!

speaker: deacon
text: Wisdom! Arise! Let us hear the Holy Gospel.

speaker: priest
text: Peace be unto all.

speaker: priest
text: The reading of the Holy Gospel according to Luke.

speaker: choir
text: Glory to Thee, O Lord, glory to Thee.
